title: Blondes, Blondes, Blondes and a Millionaire
description: Based on She Cried for Justice, the 1966 novel by Edna Bach, which tells the story of a Jewish girl who escapes the Holocaust and later discovers her former Nazi guard living nearby.
quote: That man was Gestapo. And I know because I am a Jewish refugee.
